description: APM-centric GenAI view: the AI Studio distributed trace correlated to logs. Tiles are keyed on the same trace_id / studio.run_id that OCI APM Trace Explorer uses (saved queries ai_studio_agent_fanout + ai_studio_token_cost on the octo-genai-studio service). Use this alongside APM Trace Explorer for the span waterfall; drilldowns go to Langfuse (lf.${DNS_DOMAIN}) and Grafana (grafana.${DNS_DOMAIN}).
